_comment: Schema metadata for LLM adaptiveness. Use for domain classification, table selection, and SQL generation. Each table has: description (what kind of table), business_category (for pruning), important_columns, joins, sql_hints. _join_graph defines canonical join paths for profit margin and multi-table analysis.

AUFK.description: Internal order master (SAP CO). Manufacturing orders (autyp=40), maintenance, projects. objnr links to COEP for actual costs.
AUFK.sql_hints: For costs by manufacturing: AUFK.objnr = COEP.objnr. SUM(COEP.wkgbtr) GROUP BY aufnr, kostl, werks. autyp=40 for manufacturing orders.

BSAD.description: Customer cleared items (AR). Paid/cleared customer invoice line items; historical receivables after payment.
BSAD.sql_hints: SUM(dmbtr) GROUP BY kunnr for revenue by customer. Join KNA1 for name1.

BSEG.description: Accounting document segment (FI line items). Every financial transaction: customer (D), vendor (K), GL (S), material (M).
BSEG.sql_hints: Filter koart='K' for vendor, 'D' for customer. SUM(dmbtr) GROUP BY hkont, kunnr, lifnr, kostl, prctr.

CEPC.description: Profit center master. Business unit, product line, or region for profit/cost tracking.
CEPC.sql_hints: Join BSEG or FAGLFLEXA on prctr for financial postings. Cost by profit center: BSEG JOIN CEPC ON prctr.

CKHS.description: Cost estimate header (CO-PC). Product cost estimate version, plant, costing parameters.
CKHS.sql_hints: Join CKIS on kalnr for cost breakdown. SUM(hwges) for totals.

CKIS.description: Cost estimate itemization (CO-PC). Product cost components: material, labor, overhead per component.
CKIS.sql_hints: wertn=total cost. SUM(wertn) GROUP BY matnr, werks, prctr. For profit margin: VBRP.netwr (revenue) + CKIS.wertn (cost) via MARA→KEKO→CKIS.

CKIT.description: Costing item texts (CO-PC). Long text (ltext) for cost estimate components.
CKIT.sql_hints: Join CKIS for matnr, ltext, wertn.

CKMLCR.description: Material ledger cost records. Material valuation, standard/periodic price, inventory value per period.
CKMLCR.sql_hints: salk3=inventory value. CKMLCR JOIN CKMLHD ON kalnr, SUM(salk3) GROUP BY matnr.

CKMLHD.description: Material ledger header. Links material ledger to materials, plants, vendors.
CKMLHD.sql_hints: Join CKMLCR for salk3 (value), CKMLPP for lbkum (quantity).

CKMLPP.description: Material ledger period totals. Stock quantity, receipts, consumption by period.
CKMLPP.sql_hints: lbkum=stock. SUM(lbkum) JOIN CKMLHD for stock by matnr.

COEP.description: Controlling line items. Actual cost postings for manufacturing orders (AUFK), cost centers (CSKS), profit centers.
COEP.sql_hints: wkgbtr=actual cost. For costs by manufacturing: COEP.objnr = AUFK.objnr. SUM(wkgbtr) GROUP BY aufnr, kostl, gjahr, perio.

COSP.description: Cost totals (controlling summary). Aggregated cost by period; wkg001–wkg016 = months.
COSP.sql_hints: Sum wkg001–wkg016 for monthly costs. GROUP BY kstar, gjahr.

CRHD.description: Work center header. Machines, production lines, labor groups. Used for manufacturing cost by work center.
CRHD.sql_hints: GROUP BY werks, arbpl. For costs by manufacturing: join via work center to COEP where applicable.

CSKS.description: Cost center master. Organizational units that accumulate costs. objnr links to COEP for manufacturing/cost center costs.
CSKS.sql_hints: COEP.objnr = CSKS.objnr for cost center costs. For costs by manufacturing: AUFK.kostl = CSKS.kostl; COEP.objnr = AUFK.objnr.

EBAN.description: Purchase requisition items. Request to buy materials/services; pre-PO.
EBAN.sql_hints: GROUP BY werks, matnr, lifnr. SUM(menge), preis.

EKKO.description: Purchase order header. Vendor, company, purchasing org, order date.
EKKO.sql_hints: Join EKPO SUM(netwr) GROUP BY lifnr for purchase value by vendor.

EKPO.description: Purchase order items. Material, quantity, netpr, netwr, plant.
EKPO.sql_hints: netwr=line value. SUM(netwr) GROUP BY matnr, werks. Join EKKO for lifnr.

FAGLFLEXA.description: General ledger line items (New GL). Actual postings for GL, profit center, cost center, segment.
FAGLFLEXA.sql_hints: hsl=amount. SUM(hsl) GROUP BY racct, prctr, rcntr. drcrk: S=debit, H=credit.

KEKO.description: Cost estimate header for materials. Header for material cost estimates; links to CKIS via kalnr.
KEKO.sql_hints: Join KEPH for component totals; MARA for material. VBRP→MARA→KEKO→CKIS for profit margin.

KEPH.description: Cost component split. Cost breakdown by category (material, labor, overhead).

KNA1.description: Customer master. Name, country, address, industry.
KNA1.sql_hints: kunnr=customer. Join for name1. VBRK uses kunag; KNA1 uses kunnr.

KNVP.description: Customer partner functions. AG=sold-to, RE=bill-to, WE=ship-to, RG=payer.
KNVP.sql_hints: Filter parvw for role. Join KNA1 for names.

KNVV.description: Customer sales data. Sales org, distribution channel, division per customer.
KNVV.sql_hints: GROUP BY vkorg, vkbur. Join KNA1 for name1.

KONV.description: Pricing conditions. Base price, discounts, tax. Linked via knumv to VBRK/VBAK.
KONV.sql_hints: kschl: PR00=price, K007=discount. SUM(kwert) GROUP BY kschl.

LFA1.description: Vendor master. Name, address, country, industry.
LFA1.sql_hints: lifnr=vendor. Join for name1. GROUP BY land1, brsch.

LFB1.description: Vendor company code. Payment terms, reconciliation account per company.

LFM1.description: Vendor purchasing org. Procurement, purchasing group per vendor.

LIKP.description: Outbound delivery header. Flow: Sales order → Delivery → Invoice.
LIKP.sql_hints: SUM(netwr) for delivery value. GROUP BY kunnr, route.

LIPS.description: Outbound delivery item. Material, lfimg (quantity), netwr (value), plant.
LIPS.sql_hints: SUM(lfimg) quantity, SUM(netwr) value. GROUP BY matnr, werks.

LSEG.description: Warehouse document segment. Material, plant, storage location, quantity.
LSEG.sql_hints: SUM(menge) GROUP BY matnr, lgort, werks.

MAKT.description: Material descriptions. maktx by language. Join for readable material names.
MAKT.sql_hints: Join on matnr for maktx. Filter spras for language.

MARA.description: Material master. Base material: type, UoM, material group. Root of material chain.
MARA.sql_hints: matnr=material. GROUP BY mtart, matkl. Join MAKT for maktx.

MARC.description: Material plant data. MRP controller, procurement type, safety stock, profit center.
MARC.sql_hints: GROUP BY werks, dispo. eisbe, minbe for stock.

MARM.description: Material units of measure. UoM conversions, weight, volume.

RBKP.description: Vendor invoice header. Incoming invoice from vendor; rmwwr=invoice value.
RBKP.sql_hints: SUM(rmwwr) for vendor invoice totals. GROUP BY lifnr.

RSEG.description: Vendor invoice item. Line items of vendor invoices.
RSEG.sql_hints: Join RBKP for header. Link to EKPO via ebeln.

RESB.description: Reservation/dependent requirements. Material reservations for production.

T016T.description: Industry sector texts. Industry descriptions (brtxt) by brsch.
T016T.sql_hints: Join KNA1 on brsch for industry text.

VBAK.description: Sales order header. Customer, order date, total value.
VBAK.sql_hints: vbeln=order. Join VBAP for items. SUM(netwr) for order value.

VBAP.description: Sales order items. Material, kwmeng (quantity), netwr (value), plant.
VBAP.sql_hints: SUM(netwr) order value, SUM(kwmeng) quantity. GROUP BY matnr, werks.

VBEP.description: Sales order schedule lines. Delivery date, quantity per order item.
VBEP.sql_hints: SUM(wmeng) for quantity. GROUP BY edatu for schedule.

VBFA.description: Document flow. Order→delivery→invoice. vbtyp_n: C=order, J=delivery, M=invoice.
VBFA.sql_hints: WHERE vbtyp_n='M' for invoices. Join VBAP on vbelv, VBRK on vbeln.

VBRK.description: Billing document header. Invoice number, date, kunag (customer), netwr (value).
VBRK.sql_hints: SUM(netwr) for invoice value. GROUP BY kunag. Join VBRP for items; KNA1 on kunag for name1.

VBRP.description: Billing document items. Product-level invoice: matnr, fkimg (quantity), netwr (revenue).
VBRP.sql_hints: SUM(netwr) for revenue. GROUP BY matnr, werks, prctr. For profit margin: netwr (revenue) + MBEW.stprs*FKIMG or CKIS.wertn (cost) via MARA→KEKO→CKIS or VBRP→MBEW.

MBEW.description: Material valuation (MM). Standard price (STPRS), moving average (VERPR) per material/plant/valuation type. Critical for profit margin.
MBEW.sql_hints: stprs=standard price, verpr=moving average. For profit margin: cost = MBEW.stprs * VBRP.fkimg when VPRSV=S. Join VBRP.matnr=MBEW.matnr, VBRP.werks=MBEW.bwkey.

MKPF.description: Material document header. Goods movement header: mblnr, mjahr, budat, bldat posting date.
MKPF.sql_hints: Join MSEG on mblnr+mjahr for line items. SUM(menge) for stock movements by material.

MVKE.description: Sales data for material. Sales org, distribution channel, product hierarchy (PRODH), pricing group.
MVKE.sql_hints: Join VBRP.MATNR=MVKE.MATNR for sales org hierarchy. Group by PRODH for product hierarchy analysis.

MEAN.description: International Article Numbers (EAN/UPC). Alternative material identifiers for barcode lookup.
MEAN.sql_hints: Join MARA on matnr. Filter ean11 for barcode lookup.

STKO.description: BOM header (bill of materials). Links material to BOM structure; stlnr, stlty, bmeng.
STKO.sql_hints: Join MAST for material→BOM; STPO for components (idnrk, menge).

STPO.description: BOM item (component). Component material (idnrk), quantity (menge), position.
STPO.sql_hints: idnrk=component material. Join MARA/MAKT on idnrk for component names. SUM(menge) for BOM explosion.

MSEG.description: Material document segment. Goods movement line items: matnr, menge, bwkey, werks.
MSEG.sql_hints: Join MKPF on mblnr+mjahr. SUM(menge) for stock movements by material, plant.

MAST.description: Material to BOM link. Links material (matnr) to BOM (stlnr, stlty).
MAST.sql_hints: Join MARA on matnr; STKO/STPO on stlnr for BOM structure.

BKPF.description: Accounting document header. Company code, fiscal year, document date, posting date.
BKPF.sql_hints: Join BSEG on bukrs+belnr+gjahr for line items. Filter by budat for date range.

BSID.description: Customer open items (AR). Unpaid customer invoice line items; open receivables.
BSID.sql_hints: SUM(dmbtr) for open AR by customer. Join KNA1 for name1.

BSIS.description: Vendor open items (AP). Unpaid vendor invoice line items; open payables.
BSIS.sql_hints: SUM(dmbtr) for open AP by vendor. Join LFA1 for name1.

ACDOCA.description: Universal journal (S/4). Line items with segment, profit center, cost center, GL account.
ACDOCA.sql_hints: hsl=amount. SUM(hsl) GROUP BY racct, prctr, rcntr. Alternative to FAGLFLEXA in S/4.
